newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil called 50 cts-$1 off, Brent unchanged.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil called 50 cts-$1 off, Brent unchanged.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures were expected to start 50 cents to $1 lower and Brent to open unchanged on Friday in very thin trade, brokers said.

Heavy profit-taking and selling on signals that Iraqi crude exports might resume left August Brent with a 71 cent loss on Thursday as U.S. players rushed to unwind positions ahead of the long Independence Day weekend.
With no U.S. business and much of the market's energy spent, both Brent and gas oil were expected to drift on Friday.
On Thursday August Brent closed at $18.21 a barrel and gas oil at $164.50 a tonne, down $3 on the day.
